newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FIFA SAYS KIRSTEN CAN STAY AT BAYER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA SAYS KIRSTEN CAN STAY AT BAYER.

text.p: Soccer's world governing body FIFA announced on Wednesday that Ulf Kirsten's agreement to join Portuguese club Sporting Lisbon was invalid, allowing the former German international striker to stay at Bayer Leverkusen.
Kirsten, 31, who won 49 caps for East Germany before appearing 17 times for the united German side, had signed a pre-agreement with Sporting.
However, FIFA's Status Committee ruled that his contract with Leverkusen had not been cancelled and he was free to continue in the Bundesliga.
The committee also ruled in favour of English premier league club Aston Villa in their dispute with Turkish side Fenerbahce over Dalian Atkinson.
Fenerbahce bought the burly English striker for $650,000 but have so far paid only $250,000.
The ruling said the remaining $400,000 must be paid within 30 days.
